headline: Gold and silver hold steady today, but both are well below last week's levels
summary: Gold 24K is unchanged at ₹13,762 per gram and silver is unchanged at ₹1,95,000 per kg from the previous rate, so today's move is effectively zero. Over the last 7 days, 24K gold has fallen about 4.1% (down ₹595 per gram) and silver about 4.9% (down ₹10,000 per kg). Across the 21 days of recorded history, silver has dropped about 11.4% from its ₹2,20,000 high on 26 October, while gold is down about 3.6%; the lowest point in this period was on 13 November. A stronger US dollar against the rupee and a softer global bullion market are possible reasons, though the data does not confirm the cause.
outlook: If you are not in a hurry, it may be worth comparing jeweller making charges and GST before buying, since today's rate is flat and prices have eased recently.
